risk: Human Markdown and machine JSON state may drift under concurrent edits.
mitigation: Single-writer claims for high-contention state files plus scripts/validate_agentic_state.py and CI validation.

risk: CP01 capability denominator may undercount dynamic/plugin/platform-gated surfaces.
mitigation: Multi-source extraction plus capability graph and adversarial completeness gauntlet before CP01 closes.

risk: Lexical/raw symbol classification can inflate the evidence graph and create false apparent cross-repository overlaps if interpreted as behavioral parity.
mitigation: W03 must extract registered/executable behavioral surfaces with explicit evidence strength; W04 may canonicalize only contract-equivalent behaviors while preserving provenance.

risk: A derived ContextPack can contain memory ghosting by referencing decisions, risks, claims or evidence that were not persisted in canonical ledgers.
mitigation: Generate ContextPack only from ledgers/state; cross-check every referenced ID; enforce deterministic rebuild and context validation in CI.

risk: Structural inventory requested blob sizes with git ls-tree -l against blobless partial clones, causing lazy object resolution and a 20-minute W02 timeout.
mitigation: Use tree metadata only without -l, keep size unknown, test blobless semantics and require a successful final-head four-source W02 run before closure.

risk: A derived ContextPack can contain memory ghosting by referencing decisions, risks, claims or evidence that were not persisted in canonical ledgers.
mitigation: Ledger-backed build, orphan-ID validation, deterministic byte check and Agentic Contract CI passed on 8dded8384ae113e7a9c73b21691c33a529696b60.

risk: Structural inventory requested blob sizes with git ls-tree -l against blobless partial clones, causing lazy object resolution and a 20-minute W02 timeout.
mitigation: Scanner now uses blobless tree metadata only and full four-source structural run succeeded within the new CI budget.

risk: Forced termination can discard process-group, child-kill, cleanup-process, reap and thread-join outcomes before marking termination complete.
mitigation: Return and persist a structured termination report; distinguish bounded attempt from confirmed external cleanup and test every failure outcome.

risk: Inherited adapter stderr is unbounded and unredacted, allowing log flooding or disclosure once credentials and inference payloads exist.
mitigation: Capture stderr through a bounded buffer with redaction, truncation accounting and explicit retention before W02-07 enables credential-bearing execution.

risk: Unix process-group teardown has no equivalent implementation or declared exclusion for non-Unix platforms.
mitigation: Declare the supported-platform constraint or implement and test native process containment such as Windows Job Objects before cross-platform parity claims.

risk: Main is not protected by required checks or a repository ruleset, so green CI remains advisory.
mitigation: A repository administrator must enforce exact-head required checks, review and workflow-file protection before production release.

risk: Nineteen workflows request contents: write, increasing token blast radius and accidental mutation surface.
mitigation: Reduce permissions to job scope, restrict triggers and branches, and require CAS plus path allowlists for every remaining writer.

risk: Mutable GitHub Action aliases could retarget executable third-party code without a repository commit.
mitigation: PR #31 replaced all 51 mutable refs with audited commit SHAs and added a repository-wide immutable-ref gate; exact convergence head 1988d56 passed 11 hosted workflows.
